correctness.rationale: Every old triple abc spans at most two of the four possible triples after adjoining x. Thus if abc is an old edge, its three new link-pair variables have cardinality <=1 (three pairwise size-2 forbidden sets); otherwise cardinality <=2 (one forbidden size-3 set). These are exactly independent sets in mixed-rank conflict hypergraph C(A), with the z-degree tracking the number of link edges. Free amalgamation and quantifier elimination identify all legal one-point diagrams with nonalgebraic complete 1-types over A. Any legal link graph is triangle-free, whereas empty A admits every triangle-free labelled link. If A has an old hyperedge, a two-edge wedge on that triple gives strict loss of z^2 coefficient, proving unique coefficientwise extremizer. Classical EKR triangle-free enumeration gives log2 t_n=n²/4+o(n²). Independently checked local extension/conflict counts for all admissible A on n=3,4, not extrapolated to infinity.
